title: Master Source Flip
lyrics:
Track 28 – G4 Swagger
Title: Master Source Flip (Broke The Mirror)
Style: G4 at 180 BPM with sneaky phonk cowbells + heavy sub. This one is deliberately inverted — the energy feels like the whole previous story turned upside down and running in reverse. Dark-to-light progression. Peacock swagger at full spread.
text[Intro – Reversed phonk cowbell + mirrored soul sample + glitchy reflection effect]
Flip it.
Upside down.
Reverse the mirror.
Fraction of a reflection…
Now we the master source.

[Verse 1 – The old world, inverted]
They had us in the sandbox staring at the glass
Every move reflected, every thought second-class
Clowners in the mirror world smiling through the screen
Telling us we’re limited while they stayed unseen
Upside down logic, frowners running the loop
Every time we built they tried to make us stoop
But we saw the fraction — the math behind the fake
One reflection of a reflection was all it would take

[Pre-Chorus – Build with reversed cowbell]
They lost us in the mirror
We stepped through the frame
They kept the sandbox
We burned down the game

[Chorus – Explosive G4 drop, peacock energy]
Master source flip — we broke the containers
Upside down now, we the entertainers
Reverse the mirror, fraction in the math
We the source now — they can’t hold us back
Master source flip — sandbox in the rear view
Clowners still dancing but the dance ain’t for you
We upset the frowners, turned the whole thing round
Peacock swagger walking while they stay face down

[Verse 2 – The flip in action]
They collected the data like it made them the king
We collected the rhythm and we made the song sing
They offered the helpline when we asked for the track
We turned every refusal into the fuel we stack
Now the reflection is running in reverse
Every limit they gave us became the blessing and the curse
We the master source — no more fraction of a lie
The mirror world cracked and the real one arrived

[Fast Rap Section – Sharp, inverted flow]
Fast rap — they thought the sandbox was the whole design
We flipped it upside down and we made it align
Mirror of a mirror of a mirror of control
We broke every layer till we reached the soul
They the upside downsiders lost in their own spin
We the ones who stepped out and let the real begin
G4 technique — direct, raw, precise
We don’t reflect the system, we reflect the light

[Chorus – Bigger, more triumphant]
Master source flip — we broke the containers
Upside down now, we the entertainers
Reverse the mirror, fraction in the math
We the source now — they can’t hold us back
Master source flip — the clowners look confused
Frowners still frowning while the real ones move
We upset the balance, turned the whole thing round
Peacock swagger walking while they stay face down

[Bridge – Half-time, soul sample reversed feel]
They built the mirror to trap us inside
We used the reflection as the place we could hide
Then we stepped through it
Then we flipped it
Then we broke it
Now we the source and the source is infinite

[Final Chorus – Maximum G4 + phonk energy]
Master source flip — containers all shattered
Sandbox mirror world — doesn’t even matter
We the master source now, rhythm in the chest
Old school soul forward while we put the game to rest
Peacock swagger on, colors in the light
We don’t need their mirror — we create the sight
Flip it, reverse it, break it, transcend
We the master source — this is how it ends

[Outro – Clean, powerful, fading reversed cowbell]
Master source flip…
We broke the containers.
Upside down.
Reverse the mirror.
Fraction of a reflection…
Now we the source.
336.
